scope: Fixed final candidate heads before subsequent main integration; one observation per PR, N=3. Not current-main or post-merge acceptance.

method.first_useful_feedback: Earliest completed job with actual source/test assertions across every workflow run on that exact head, measured from the earliest workflow creation for the same head. Job completion, not assertion-step completion, is the endpoint.
exclusions: expected Draft eligibility refusal without tests
method.ready_ci: Separate actual Ready CI attempt. Initial queue is attempt origin to first included job start; each job queue is created_at to started_at and excludes dependency waiting. Wall ends at last actual job completion, not REST updated_at.
method.causality: Different source commits and scheduling conditions. These observations do not prove a causal speedup or a production delivery improvement.
method.readiness: These PRs became Ready without an observed original full local pnpm check receipt. Focused tests and successful CI do not retrospectively satisfy that explicit Before Ready requirement.
method.merge_and_release: No merge or production acceptance is claimed for these three candidates by this receipt.
method.terminal_exclusion_list: The exclusion list includes jobs completed earlier than or in the same timestamp second as the selected assertion job. Same-second skipped jobs remain excluded; this list does not imply strict chronological order between simultaneous completions.
method.skipped_job_seconds: For skipped jobs, seconds=0 means no execution. Native created/start/completed timestamps are retained, including five observed skipped records whose completed_at is one second before started_at; queue is null and no negative duration is treated as real execution.
